labels.label: theo:universality_tori

hypotheses.paper: Phi_i in Aff(T^d), linear part in SL_d(Z) (main.tex:283-286)
hypotheses.note: IsUnit (A i).det (GL_d(Z)), as in EGF/TorusFamilies.lean; the minimal, RL and cat-map instances use SL_2(Z) matrices

hypotheses.paper: the set of moves stable under inverse (main.tex:820)
hypotheses.note: dropped: the S^-1 and T^-1 moves of EGF.minimalMoves carry translations of their own (b 1, b 3), exact inverses being the special case b 1 = -S^-1 b 0, b 3 = -T^-1 b 2; only the S-move and the T-move are used (their commutator)

hypotheses.paper: the group generated by the moves violates (ii) of Theorem 5 of bekka2015spectral (main.tex:818-820)
hypotheses.note: replaced by: the group generated by the moves contains an affine map whose linear part has no periodic integer vector (EGF.universality_tori_of_mem_noPeriodic; for the paper's moves it is proved, not assumed: the cat map T S T^-1 S^-1) or a Kronecker translation (EGF.universality_tori_of_mem_translation); no named Prop, no spectral gap

hypotheses.paper: 'the group generated by the linear part of the Phi_i is the whole group SL_d(Z)' (main.tex:293)
hypotheses.note: EGF.universality_tori_sl, for every d >= 2, in the weaker form 'the group generated by the linear parts contains SL_d(Z)' (hgen); the minimal moves meet it (EGF.minimalMoves_generate, Mathlib's SpecialLinearGroup.SL2Z_generators); false as a sufficient condition at d = 1 (EGF.not_universality_tori_sl_one)

hypotheses.paper: SL_d(Z) has a presentation with two generators (conder2025generating, main.tex:293)
hypotheses.note: not used: at d = 2 the moves S, T suffice by the commutator; for any d >= 2 the hypothesis is generation of a group containing SL_d(Z) by whatever moves; one move suffices (EGF.exists_universality_tori_single_move)

hypotheses.paper: the model of the family, unspecified (main.tex:288)
hypotheses.note: IsRichToroidalModel A b F (C-31, EGF/TorusFamilies.lean), needed (EGF.not_isUniversalFamilyEps_constOutflow); every theorem is non-vacuous through l2ToroidalModel (fixed translations) or EGF.l2ToroidalModelFree (translations as parameters, main.tex:288 read literally)
in the epsilon-form of record IsUniversalFamilyEps volume F (DEC-141)
on T^1 the hypothesis is one move x -> x + c with c of infinite order (EGF.universality_tori_one); SL_1(Z) is trivial and the route of l.818-821 never applies (EGF.bgConditionII_dim_one)

findings: main.tex:1022 ('Theoretically minimal EGF with four affine moves on the torus T^2') and main.tex:493 ('the minimal four affine transformations'): four is minimal for the paper's own sufficient condition (the smallest inverse-closed set of moves whose linear parts generate SL_2(Z); l.1022 glosses 'minimal' as 'two generators and their inverse', and l.698 says two transformations suffice), not in the number of moves needed for universality: one move suffices. A single move x -> [[2,1],[1,1]] x + b, any b, with a rich model gives an epsilon-universal family on T^2 (EGF.universality_tori_cat, non-vacuous by EGF.universality_tori_cat_l2); in every dimension d >= 2 a single move x -> Mx + b with M in SL_d(Z) suffices (EGF.exists_universality_tori_single_move), and in every dimension one translation x -> x + c for almost every c (EGF.ae_universality_tori_translation). By C-29 only ergodicity of the group of the moves matters, and one ergodic element suffices (EGF.isGroupErgodic_of_ergodic_mem). The four moves of l.293 are sufficient (EGF.universality_tori_minimal), for every choice of their translations.

main.tex:293 ('the technical assumptions above is in particular satisfied if the group generated by the linear part of the Phi_i is the whole group SL_d(Z)'): with the corrected condition (ergodicity of the group of the moves, C-28/C-29), proved for every d >= 2 and every choice of translations (EGF.universality_tori_sl), since SL_d(Z) contains an element without periodic integer vector (EGF.exists_noPeriodicVector_det_one: block diagonals of the cat map and of the companion matrix of x^3 - x - 1, proved via irreducibility over Q and Bezout); so l.293 for d >= 3 no longer rests on l.821 (free subgroups) nor on conder2025generating. At d = 1 the criterion is false: every family of T^1 has linear parts generating SL_1(Z) = {1}, yet the identity move with the L2 model is not epsilon-universal (EGF.not_universality_tori_sl_one); on T^1 one translation of infinite order is needed and suffices (EGF.universality_tori_one, EGF.universality_tori_one_sqrt_two). In l.820's printed form, 'in particular satisfied' also fails for the inverse-stability clause unless each inverse move's translation is matched (not formalized; the corrected condition drops inverse-stability).

main.tex:149 ('in any dimension on tori and spheres, this criterion can be fulfilled with four simple transformations'): for tori, confirmed in every dimension d >= 1, and with one transformation for the criterion as corrected by C-29 (ergodicity; a one-move family is never summably L2-mixing, EGF.not_isSummablyL2Mixing_of_map_eq, so the criterion of Theorem 3.4 as printed needs more than one) (d = 1: an irrational translation; every d: almost every translation; d >= 2: one move in SL_d(Z)).

main.tex:697 ('for instance on tori, one randomly initialized non-trainable translation is sufficient to ensure ergodicity'): confirmed in every dimension: almost every translation of T^d is ergodic (EGF.ae_ergodic_torusAffine_one, Kronecker by Fourier: EGF.ergodic_torusAffine_one_of_mFourier_ne_one, EGF.ae_mFourier_ne_one), and with a rich model the family with that one move is epsilon-universal (EGF.ae_universality_tori_translation). main.tex:698 ('two transformations are sufficient'): true, not tight; one suffices (C-29).

main.tex:440 (RL experiment, 16 transformations): in both readings of C-34 (12 moves: 8 translations and S^{+-1}, T^{+-1}; 20 moves: 16 translations, which include 8 translations and their inverses, and S^{+-1}, T^{+-1}) the family is epsilon-universal with a rich model for every choice of the translations, the harness's rational ones included (EGF.universality_tori_rl, non-vacuous by EGF.universality_tori_rl_l2): the translations play no role in universality.
questions: main.tex:293 and :1022, 'the two generators': the generators of SL_2(Z) are not named. Reading taken: S = [[0,-1],[1,0]] and T = [[1,1],[0,1]] (EGF.matS, EGF.matT, Mathlib's ModularGroup.S/T). Any set of moves whose linear parts generate SL_2(Z) is covered by EGF.universality_tori_sl (d = 2), so the result does not depend on the reading.

main.tex:293, 'their inverse': exact inverses of the moves (x -> S^-1 x - S^-1 b) or moves with linear part S^-1 and a translation of their own. Reading taken: the latter (translations free, EGF.minimalMoves with b : Fin 4 -> T^2 arbitrary); exact inverses are the special case b 1 = -S^-1 b 0, b 3 = -T^-1 b 2.

main.tex:440, '2 elements of SL_d(Z)': which two is not said. Reading taken: S and T (the surviving harness, C-34). For other choices EGF.universality_tori_of_mem_noPeriodic applies as soon as the group of the moves contains a matrix without periodic integer vector (e.g. any hyperbolic element, EGF.noPeriodicVector_of_two_lt_trace).

main.tex:493 and :1022, 'minimal': reading taken: the minimal number of moves achieving universality, which is 1, not 4 (finding 1). In the other reading, 'the smallest inverse-closed set of generators of SL_2(Z)', the claim is not addressed here.

corrections.notes: Tori half, proved sorry-free (standard axioms only). The corrected Theorem 3.5's clause 'when it contains an affine map whose linear part has no periodic integer vector (e.g. T(STS^-1)^-1 = [[2,1],[1,1]] for the minimal four moves) or, on T^1, a translation of infinite order': EGF.ergodic_torusAffine_of_noPeriodic (Fourier: f^(k) = e_{-k}(b) f^(A^T k), constant modulus along an injective orbit, Parseval) with EGF.universality_tori_of_mem_noPeriodic (group of the moves) and EGF.universality_tori_minimal (minimal four moves, every translation, through the commutator EGF.mem_torusAffineGroup_commutator: T S T^-1 S^-1 = catMat, EGF.matT_mul_matS_mul_inv, which agrees with the corrected text's T(STS^-1)^-1); EGF.universality_tori_one on T^1. The corrected l.293 sentence ('for d >= 2, if the group generated by the linear parts is the whole SL_d(Z) ... and for d = 1 if one translation part is irrational'): EGF.universality_tori_sl (every d >= 2; the stretch landed: EGF.exists_noPeriodicVector_det_one, so the registered 'd >= 3 rests on l.821 ... unless the stretch lands' can be updated: d >= 3 no longer rests on l.821), EGF.universality_tori_two_of_specialLinearGroup (d = 2 without the stretch), EGF.minimalMoves_generate (the minimal moves meet it), EGF.not_universality_tori_sl_one (the criterion is false at d = 1, so the corrected sentence's 'for d >= 2' is needed), EGF.universality_tori_one with EGF.addOrderOf_coe_eq_zero_of_irrational (irrational translation part, d = 1).

'one such map suffices, against l.698's count': EGF.isGroupErgodic_of_ergodic_mem (one ergodic element makes the generated group ergodic, from Mathlib's QuasiErgodic.ae_empty_or_univ0); one move suffices for universality: EGF.universality_tori_cat (T^2), EGF.exists_universality_tori_single_move (every d >= 2), EGF.ae_universality_tori_translation (every d, almost every translation, l.697). Not combined in Lean here with EGF.not_isSummablyL2Mixing_of_map_eq (EGF/MixingCriteria.lean), which would make the a.e.-translation family a C-29 witness (universal, not summably mixing) in every dimension; the master may add it.

kb_proposals: Fourier on the torus with the global volume: Mathlib's AddCircleMulti lemmas (mFourierCoeff, hasSum_mFourier_series_L2, hasSum_sq_mFourierCoeff, coeFn_mFourierLp) are elaborated against a local MeasureSpace UnitAddCircle := haarAddCircle. EGF.volume_unitAddTorus_eq_pi_haar (rw [<- h]; rfl with h : volume = haarAddCircle from volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle) bridges; transport MemLp by hmu ▸ hf to Measure.pi (fun _ => haarAddCircle), build Lp elements with MemLp.toLp there, and the coefficients of toLp f equal those of f by integral_congr_ae (no measure rewriting inside Lp types). EGF.mFourierCoeff_eq_integral_volume and EGF.mFourier_apply_eq_toCircle (e_k(x) = toCircle (sum k_i x_i)) turn every character identity into one in R/Z.

Ergodicity on tori: EGF.ergodic_of_mFourierCoeff (an invariant L2 function with no non-zero frequency, applied to an invariant indicator) + EGF.isGroupErgodic_of_ergodic_mem + EGF.universality_tori_of_ergodic. Hyperbolic linear part: EGF.ergodic_torusAffine_of_noPeriodic; translations: EGF.ergodic_torusAffine_one_of_mFourier_ne_one; a.e. Kronecker: the image of volume under a surjective character is Haar (isAddHaarMeasure_map_of_isFiniteMeasure + isAddHaarMeasure_eq_of_isProbabilityMeasure). There is no NoAtoms instance for volume on AddCircle at this pin: volume {0} = 0 by Metric.closedBall_zero + AddCircle.volume_closedBall.

Integer matrices without periodic vector: EGF.NoPeriodicVector A <-> forall n > 0, det(A^n - 1) != 0 (Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff over the domain Z). SL_2: det(X - 1) = 2 - tr X and the trace recursion (EGF.noPeriodicVector_of_two_lt_trace). Block diagonals: Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) seen as Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv Z Z (map_pow, map_sub, map_one), det by det_reindex_self + det_fromBlocks_zero21. An irreducible cubic over Q: irreducible_of_degree_le_three_of_not_isRoot (import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.SpecificDegree) + exists_integer_of_is_root_of_monic (Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.RationalRoot), compute_degree! / monicity! (Mathlib.Tactic.ComputeDegree); then Irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd gives Bezout, evaluated by Polynomial.aeval at the matrix over Q ((Int.castRingHom Q).mapMatrix).

SL_2(Z) = <S, T> is Mathlib's SpecialLinearGroup.SL2Z_generators (root namespace, Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.FixedDetMatrices); ModularGroup.S and ModularGroup.T are definitionally !![0,-1;1,0] and !![1,1;0,1]; push to (Matrix n n Z)^x with Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL and MonoidHom.map_closure, and identify with Matrix.nonsingInvUnit by Units.ext rfl. The linear parts of the group of the moves contain the group generated by the A_i: EGF.coe_mem_linearParts_of_mem_closure.

Pitfalls at this pin: the notation Q[X] needs `open Polynomial` at section level (an `open ... in` before a tactic does not reach the statement); `not_imp` is ambiguous (root vs Classical) and `_root_.not_imp` is deprecated: use Classical.not_imp; a `set` variable hides its body from rw (simp only [hdef] first); simp on entries of `X.trace • X - X.det • 1` turns the scalars into Int casts into matrices: first simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul], then fin_cases.
